theme.note: brand paper #f5f5f3 (owner said «#f5f5f5 / white»: 1/255 difference, the brand value is used). Ink/dark-grey for the grid, dark gold #856727 for every thin line and small text on paper, light gold #c9a96a only on photos (wipe edges) and in the gold piece/glow.
theme.logo_note: garon-logo-light.svg = DARK logo for LIGHT backgrounds (fills #1e1e1e, gradients gmlight #a3a3a3→#4f4f4f and gglight #d4b57a→#b8955c). Path data and the <rect> are byte-identical to garon-logo-dark.svg, so every geometry number of v2 (clips, pieces, wordmark glyph bounds, box) is unchanged.

easings.note: CSS cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2) control points; evaluate exactly like CSS (solve x(t)=p by Newton/bisection, return y(t)).

R2.keyframes_rule: Every animated property is a list of keys [frame, value, easing]. Before the first key: first value; after the last key: last value. Between key k and k+1: v = v_k + (v_k+1 − v_k) · E((f − f_k)/(f_k+1 − f_k)), E = easing NAMED IN KEY k (see `easings`). "hold" = keep v_k until f_k+1 then jump. Vector values ([x,y] or {x,y,w,h}) interpolate component-wise.
R2.fonts_check: Armenian glyphs must come from Noto Serif Armenian / Noto Sans Armenian (check document.fonts / computed font in a test frame). STOP if a fallback system font is used.

intro.what: NEW 'blueprint → solid' build (no text): the three mark shapes are DRAWN as thin dark-gold outline strokes with registration crosses and dimension lines, then 'poured' solid from the ground up (BIG, MID — like concrete filling formwork, a gold level line rides the surface), then the gold piece fills on the beat with a glint; the real wordmark tracks in (as v4). At f120 the ground line opens like a shutter into the first photo.

pairs.align_note: different viewpoints (not alignable): the slider reads as a comparison, not an in-place morph — this is why A is the shortest pair

pair_impl.divider: p ∈ [0,1] (keys per pair). Divider x = 70 + 940·p. LEFT of the divider = BEFORE, right = AFTER (p=1: all before, p=0: all after).
pair_impl.layers: pair layer (full frame, entry clip) → window box (overflow hidden) → [after wrap] + [before clip box: clip-path inset(0 (940 − (xd − 70))px 0 0) → before wrap]. Both wraps get the SAME transform so the halves stay registered.
pair_impl.push: wrap transform = translate(dx,dy) scale(z) with transform-origin = anchor (fractions of the window). Micro camera drift: dx = 2.5·sin(f/41), dy = 2·sin(f/53 + 1) px (deterministic, never exposes an edge because z ≥ 1.01).
pair_impl.crop: image placed as in L02: scale = 940/(crop.w·SW); left = −crop.x·SW·scale; top = −crop.y·SH·scale. Crops have the window aspect 0.7502.
pair_impl.parallax_2_5D: inside each wrap: base + a FOREGROUND copy of the same in a div with -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent (mask_y − feather/2)·100%, #000 (mask_y + feather/2)·100%) and transform scale(extra_scale) with transform-origin origin → the ground plane grows faster than the building/sky = depth. Same values on before and after (stays registered).

gold_piece.shape_note: the GOLD path of the logo relative to its anchor (330, 132.5) in mark units
gold_piece.g: px per unit: g = 1.6 for f ≤ e; g = 1.6·32^E((f−e)/12) for e < f ≤ e+12, E = inOutCubic (→ 51.2: the polygon covers the window from e+12)
gold_piece.formula: incoming shot layer clipped to (anchor + g·shape_unit) ∩ window

gold_fill.css: same clip polygon filled with linear-gradient(135deg,#d4b57a,#b8955c), layer above the shots
gold_fill.opacity: relative keys [[e−4,0,outSine],[e−1,1,hold],[e+3,1,outSine],[e+10,0]] — a small solid gold piece (141 px wide) appears in the window centre on the beat before e, then grows and opens into the next shot

pair_impl.handle: vertical 2 px #c9a96a line over the window height at xd (box-shadow theme.divider_shadow); handle = 72 px circle centred (xd, 1016), fill theme.handle_fill, border 1.5 px #c9a96a, shadow theme.handle_shadow, two chevrons ‹ › (svg polylines, stroke #856727 2 px, drawn in a 64-unit viewBox scaled to the handle, ±12 units from centre). transform scale(handle_grab). Line visible when handle opacity > 0 OR 0 < p < 1.
pair_impl.indicator: top-right slider indicator under the stage label: track x 874–1010, y 352, 2 px rgba(23,25,28,0.16); lit part x 874 … 874+136·p in #856727; dot 8 px #856727 at x 874+136·p. Mirrors the active divider. Opacity follows the section labels.

audio.file_rule: Owner preference: ONLY the intro has sound, then silence (music is added in the Instagram app). Generate with `python3 marketing/instagram/tools/compose_l02_audio.py intro_r2.wav --r2` (24.0 s WAV: sound 0–4.6 s, digital silence after 4.6 s; ticks/pour/impact/glint/shutter timed to this item). The default L02 output of the script is unchanged.

beat_map.event: pad fades in with the grid; ground line draws
tick: GOLD outline; dimension lines draw
POUR: BIG/MID fill rise from the ground (low rising noise 1.1–2.0 s)
DOWNBEAT: horizon shutter opens on the night house (open whoosh + low hit) — the in-app track should start its first strong downbeat HERE; intro sound fades out 4.0–4.6 s
one sweep: all three become «Հետո» (biggest accent)
end card: groove drops out, resolve

audio.mood: In-app track by MOOD, not by name: modern minimal / architectural, warm, ~120 BPM, felt piano or soft pluck, deep sub, no vocals, no EDM drop. Slide the track so its first strong downbeat lands at 4.0 s.

photo_rules.sources: ONLY the owner's GARON projects: pool-A, pool-B, house-A from enhanced/ (owner-approved), no stock, no AI. (house-B-wood originals are NOT used in R2 — no 'before' exists for it; it stays the hero of L02.)
photo_rules.resolution: scale vs ORIGINAL pixels ≤ 1.35 (see pairs[].max_scale_vs_original, triptych.max_scale_vs_original). Tightest: house-A/02 (960x1280) 1.349.

R2.alt_hy: Կարճ տեսանյութ բաց ֆոնի վրա։ Ճարտարապետական ցանցի վրա GARON նշանը նախ գծվում է բարակ ոսկեգույն ուրվագծերով, հետո լցվում է ներքևից վերև, ոսկեգույն մասը լցվում է վերջինը, հայտնվում է GARON CONSTRUCTION գրությունը։ Հետո՝ «Առաջ / Հետո» համեմատություններ ոսկեգույն սահիչով. պատրաստի տունը գիշերը՝ լուսավոր գծերով, հետո նույն տունը բետոնե կմախքի փուլում, և նորից պատրաստի տեսքը։ Լողավազան. բետոնե ավազան ջակուզիով, հետո նույնը՝ կապույտ խճանկարով։ Մեկ այլ լողավազան. ամրանավորում, հետո պատրաստի լողավազան քարե պատի մոտ։ Վերջում երեք նախագծերը կողք կողքի, մեկ շարժումով դառնում են պատրաստի։ Վերջին կադրում՝ լոգոն, «Առաջ | Հետո», «Լողավազաններ · Տներ · Վերանորոգում» և garon.am։
